items.source: Formatter implementation for a JSR-310 Instant, following JSR-310's parsing rules for an Instant (that is, not using a configurable DateTimeFormatter): accepting the default ISO_INSTANT format as well as RFC_1123_DATE_TIME (which is commonly used for HTTP date header values).
